title: Bank of Baroda Launches 'bob SAMVAD' AI Multilingual In-Branch Platform
summary: BoB launches industry-first AI-driven speech & language tool supporting real-time two-way communication across 22 Indian languages.

blocks.title: 📰 3. 🏦 BANKING & INSURANCE NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 Bank of Baroda Launches 'bob SAMVAD' AI Multilingual In-Branch Platform. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Bank of Baroda launched **'bob SAMVAD'**, an in-house developed AI conversational platform enabling real-time translation between customers and branch staff across **22 scheduled languages** in 250 pilot branches.
